name: team-decisions
description: A team decides which agent patch lands: one candidate ask goes to two human reviewers of the desk (ic1, ic2), their text votes join through a threshold-2 tally that answers the direction, the direction's summary is one run stdout line, and the same answer is the gate item the lead answers; the lead's call drives the merge, an effect that runs git merge --no-ff on the branch the argv whitelist names, in the scratch repo examples/team/prepare-repo.mjs builds.

neurons.description: Where the candidate enters: the ask whole (title, why, draft, proposal, options, answerable_by), keyed by the candidate's id (replaces).
Ada's review: which patch this team merges. The desk item carries answerable_by: ic.
Lin's review: the same item, one desk item of its own. answerable_by: ic.

The quorum join (5.2, on the file-mode pattern of timbre's reviewers): holds one vote, fires when both ICs have voted, and answers the direction - { mode: quorum, branch } or { mode: tie }; agreement settles it, disagreement leaves it to the lead.

Prints the direction as its stdout summary: 'settled by quorum: agent/patch-a' or 'tie - the lead decides'. No outgoing links: the run's stdout carries it, and the demo prints it from the live stream.
The gate of the lead (Sam): merge the settled branch, or refuse - on a tie, break it. The desk item carries answerable_by: lead.

The merge (11, effect: a started call is never cut, a failure records unknown): merge.mjs receives the lead's answer, validates the branch against the argv whitelist (nothing else, no shell, no eval) and runs git merge --no-ff it in the scratch repo, tagging team-decision on success.
